title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-01-17

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a hissy‑muddy edge, yet the early ’68 show shines thanks to a scorching Spanish Jam and the classic Dark Star → China Cat → The Eleven sequence.
ai_review.review: Despite some hiss and muddiness that betray its later‑generation source, this soundboard capture lets the raw brilliance of the Dead’s January 17, 1968 performance shine through.  The band delivers a fiery Spanish Jam, a fast‑paced Dark Star that segues into a standout China Cat and an early version of The Eleven, all backed by Garcia’s soaring vocals and blistering Gibson work.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers award 4‑5 stars and praise the musical performance; recording quality is mixed but still listenable, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as hissy/muddy and sourced from later‑generation material; some reviewers find it decent enough for the music, while others note clarity issues but no catastrophic dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early ’68 set is energetic and psychedelic, highlighted by a tight Dark Star → China Cat → Eleven trio that foreshadows later improvisational peaks; the two‑set structure includes lively banter and a mix of pig‑numbers, anthem tunes, and surf‑style jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s fast, flamenco‑flavored guitar on the Spanish Jam and his soaring voice on China Cat are repeatedly praised; his Gibson work dominates the recording.
